name: IntegrateIT LIFX
notes: Local Control4 driver for a single LIFX device over the vendor's published LAN protocol — UDP binary on port 56700, no cloud and no account. Broadcast discovery finds LIFX devices on the subnet; you bind one, then control power, color (HSBK), and white temperature with polled state feedback. Confirmed LIFX Z / Beam strips add per-zone color, gradients, and the Move effect; confirmed matrix devices (Tile, Candle, Ceiling, Path, Spot, Tube, Luna, Mirror) add whole-matrix color and the MORPH / FLAME / SKY firmware effects; confirmed LIFX Clean bulbs add HEV clean cycles; and a confirmed LIFX Switch adds relay control for the dumb loads wired to it. Every capability is unknown until the device proves it, and unproven commands are refused by name.
